newsitem.title: UK: IBCA affirms CRH Plc ratings.
newsitem.headline: IBCA affirms CRH Plc ratings.

text.p: IBCA, the European credit rating agency, said on Thursday it affirmed CRH Plc's A long-term and A1 short-term ratings.
This followed Wednesday's announcement that CRH is to acquire Tilcon Inc, the U.S. construction materials group, from BTR Plc, IBCA said in a statement.

"The ratings are affirmed on the grounds that the acquisition strenghens CRH's position in the U.S. aggregates market and that its financial risk does not increase significantly as a result of the acquisition," IBCA said. "CRH is already present in the U.S. aggreagates, asphalt and readymixed concrete market and the Tilcon acquisition will make the group the largest construction materials group in the Northeastern and Mountain states."
"The U.S. Justice Department is, however, requiring the disposal of one Connecticut quarry and asphalt plant on anti-trust grounds," the rating agency said.
"Although this is the largest individual acquisition by CRH, it is consistent with past acquisitions that have largely been undertaken in existing businesses and markets," IBCA said.
